blocks.text: Contact Center Solutions Built for BPOs
Match your current BPO needs with software that offers expansion as your business grows.
Boost Your BPO's Functionality

The right technology can help your BPO function to it’s best capacity with smart workflows, high customer satisfaction levels, and optimum agent and resource utilization. With changing local and global dynamics, scattered work teams, and a far more discerning customer, transforming your system to one that allows for flexibility, cost savings, and the ability to scale is the need of the hour. You need a cost effective, enterprise grade call center solution that lets you scale up or scale down on a monthly-basis—as per your seasonal demands— to keep operational costs lower. A reliable system that can integrate with other solutions and use data, AI & omnichannel capabilities to enable optimum performance.
Lowers Operating Costs
Using CXDYNAMIQ, businesses have reduced total cost of operations by 50%
Flexible monthly plans
You can increase/ downsize agents instantly, as per seasonal demand.
Cost-effective
Best price points. Free CRM integrations, deployment & customer support.
Flexible deployment options
Pure, Hybrid, & Private Cloud options. Can combine with existing Legacy PBX. Let’s you choose your SIP trunks.
Get Started
Grow with CXDYNAMIQ
Here is why CXDYNAMIQ is uniquely placed to serve growing business needs.
Easily scale your business

Add and remove someone from your team or CRM seamlessly. So you can expand your platform and team effortlessly to meet your activity levels.Our flexible, monthly, pay-as-you-go pricing makes it easy for you to scale up or downsize anytime. And our international presence with local phone number availability across 160+ countries ensures that we can support your expansion plans across the country or world. With CXDYNAMIQ, you get enterprise-grade features right from the start, and you can add more AI-based capabilities as and when you need them.
Optimize customer experience with the CXDYNAMIQ CX Hub

Build the seamless, fast, personalized communications your modern customer craves.CXDYNAMIQ CX hub is the easiest way for contact centers to explore omnichannel capabilities. Our unified platform enables you to use the same teams to handle calls, chats, and social media. This makes it easy for you to explore and scale new digital channels without any heavy investments or team-building efforts. Moreover, our in-built contact manager helps you ensure a consistent customer experience even before you’re ready to invest in a CRM. And our chatbots can ensure high efficiency and low cost of operations while giving customers the 24 x 7 availability and fast responses they crave.
CXDYNAMIQ BPO call center features
CXDYNAMIQ Auto dialers come packed with every tool and feature you need to run a successful outbound campaign.
